title: 第2556章 压垮伊莎稻草第2555章 神助攻塞肉到嘴边
content_zh:
推荐各位书友阅读：乡村麒麟神医第一卷：默认第2556章压垮伊莎稻草！（..la）看着他们前赴后继离开，刚从那边过来李向东。
要是放着屋子里貌美骑士不管，再跑那边去凑热闹。
只怕要被他们嘲笑。
掐个手诀收起应元纸人，摇头晃脑走向房间。
刚推门进去。
扔在地上爬都爬不起伊莎克莱，双臂撑地神色慌张往后挪。
满脸惊恐嘶吼：“别过来，你再过来我就咬舌自尽！”
呵，呵呵......
李向东大名鼎鼎李神医，修出药神道在身。
真要对她有想法。
别说咬舌自尽，就算抹脖子自尽也能救回来。
更不要说她这种级别圣痕骑士，咬舌根本就自不了尽。
只会咬成个哑巴。
身形一闪蹿到她身边。
蹲下身笑嘻嘻警告：“你要喜欢咬你尽管咬，只要咬不死，你的价值半点不会少。”
“等他们开口要人。”
“我就把你送回去。
“你自己去面对你教会骑士主教，亦或者更高级别教皇，以及你伊莎克莱家族之人。”
说完不搭理她，走到石头雕刻而成，梆硬座椅上坐下。
手撑下巴看着她咬。

她却不咬了。
躺在地上大声叫骂：
“奸贼！”
“你们华夏人都是些可耻奸贼，只会玩见不得光龌龊手段，上帝不会放过你们！”
啥？
上帝？
李向东才融合三色土，通过莉莉丝残留其中残影，挖出她西方上帝造人背后隐藏真相。
她就用上帝来威胁。
有意思。
真有意思。
掏出根烟点燃。
深吸一口吐出。
烟雾缭绕间，一道气定神闲悠长定调传入她耳：“别扯什么有罪，死后下地狱哪一套。”
“如果真有罪。”
“你们上帝才是第一个罪人，是他设计的七宗罪，弄出罪名让你们西方人往里钻。”
“鬼扯，鬼扯！”伊莎克莱就胡乱诅咒两句出出气。
可恶的华夏人却打蛇随棍上，把她最敬重上帝拉下水。
这让她如何能忍。
气冲颅顶怒不可遏，腰腹一挺鲤鱼打挺，不靠手不靠脚，靠着强大腰腹核心坐起。
神情亢奋眼神凌厉喝骂：

“你个该死的东西，你知道你在说什么吗？”
content_en:

Just opened the door and went in.
Issa Clay couldn't get up even after being thrown to the ground. She put her arms on the ground and moved back in a panic.
He screamed with fear on his face: "Don't come over here, if you come over again I will bite my tongue and commit suicide!"
Hehe, hehe...
Li Xiangdong, the famous Doctor Li, cultivated the divine way of medicine.
I really want to think about her.
Not to mention biting your tongue and committing suicide, you can still save yourself even if you wipe your neck and commit suicide.
Not to mention that a Stigma Knight of her level would never stop biting her tongue.
It will only bite you into silence.
The figure jumped to her side in a flash.
He knelt down and warned with a smile: "Bite me if you like, but as long as I can't be bitten to death, your value will not be less."
"Wait until they ask for someone."
"I'll send you back.
"Go and face the knight-bishop of your church, the higher-level pope, and the people of your Isaclay family. "
After saying that, he ignored her and walked to the hard seat carved out of stone and sat down.
He put his chin on his hand and watched her bite.
But she stopped biting.
Lying on the ground and yelling:
"Traitor! "
“You Chinese people are all shameful traitors who only play dirty tricks. God will not let you go! "
What?
God?
Li Xiangdong only fused the three-color soil, and through the residual image of Lilith, he dug out the hidden truth behind her creation of human beings by the Western God.
She threatened God.
Interesting.
How interesting.
Take out a cigarette and light it.
Take a deep breath and spit it out.
In the midst of the smoke, a calm and long tone came to her ears: "Don't talk about being guilty and going to hell after death. "
"If you are really guilty. "
"Your God is the first sinner. He designed the seven deadly sins and came up with crimes for you Westerners to burrow into. "
"What nonsense, what nonsense! "Issac Clay cursed a few random words to vent her anger.
The hateful Chinese people beat the snake and followed it with a stick, dragging down the God she respected the most.
How could she endure this?
Angry and angry, he straightened his waist and abdomen like a carp, and sat up without relying on his hands or feet, relying on his strong waist and abdominal core.
He looked excited and shouted with sharp eyes:
“You damn thing, do you know what you’re talking about? "
